paragraphs.text: Albatross Alley is a stretch of ocean off the coast of Jamuraa , on the plane of Dominaria .

Although the exact location of Albatross Alley, so named for its position as a lane for the great wandering seabirds, is unclear, it lies somewhere off the coast of southwestern Jamuraa , probably tangent to the Sea of Serenity . Albatross Alley is used as a delineator of north and south groups of islands in the seas outside Jamuraa, where only the islands that lie south of the Alley are volcanic, while the islands north of the Alley do not feature volcanoes.
